purpose: Reproduce the visual fidelity achieved in Tree while keeping product semantics, behavior and security authoritative.
tree_principles_applied: frontend is consequence of semantic/operational foundation, not the source of product meaning
prove one calibration screen before extracting a Design System
Stitch is a visual laboratory, not the source of product entities/flows/permissions
approved render has precedence over conflicting generator metadata for visual decisions
after visual approval, GitHub + normalized tokens + reusable components become executable source of truth
fidelity is measured systematically, not by 'looks close'
new pages reuse shell/density/language and extend the system only when a real domain need requires it

pipeline.name: SEMANTIC PRECONDITION
pipeline.gate: No visual generation until the page owner, entities, actions, states and next transitions are known.

pipeline.name: CALIBRATION SCREEN
pipeline.gate: Screen resolves shell, density, hierarchy, surfaces, tables/lists, status language and brand translation.

pipeline.name: JSON EXTRACTION
pipeline.rule: Record visual gaps separately from product gaps. Never let extraction erase semantic requirements.

pipeline.name: NORMALIZATION
actions: separate domain components from generic primitives
pipeline.gate: A new page can be composed mostly from existing tokens/components without redrawing the product language.

pipeline.name: IMPLEMENTATION
pipeline.rule: Reuse AppShell, spacing, density, typography and existing components first. Introduce a new primitive only with a documented domain or UX need.

pipeline.name: FIDELITY AUDIT
pipeline.gate: No accumulated drift. Differences are either corrected or explicitly documented as page-specific requirements.

pipeline.name: CONSOLIDATION
actions: freeze decisions that now have evidence
pipeline.gate: Next page starts from the updated system, not from a fresh Stitch invention.

page_creation_rule.default: NEW PAGE = existing archetype + existing shell + existing primitives + domain components + page-specific data/state contract
new_pattern_allowed_only_when: a required domain behavior cannot be expressed by current components
the page archetype is genuinely new
operational evidence shows the current pattern fails
page_creation_rule.new_pattern_process: document need -> design candidate -> audit against canon -> implement -> promote only after page gate

fidelity_scoring_without_subjective_rank.note: Use pass/fail tolerances by dimension rather than an aesthetic score.

dimensions.shell: same navigation frame, canvas behavior and content width logic
dimensions.density: information volume per region matches archetype
dimensions.semantics: same state uses same visual treatment everywhere
dimensions.components: same component anatomy; no page-local clone
dimensions.responsive: breakpoints preserve hierarchy and action reachability

artifacts_per_page: component/token updates only when evidence warrants
anti_drift_rules: Do not ask Stitch to invent a page from only a name.
Do not copy Tailwind classes from a generated page as the final Design System without normalization.
Do not change shell or global density to solve a local page problem.
Do not create a near-duplicate component because one page needs a small variant.
Do not use screenshots as long-term implementation source after components/tokens are versioned.
Do not treat a visually absent state as a nonexistent product state.
Do not declare page complete before operational and fidelity gates pass.
